title: Document retirement exemption for federation placement capacity accounting
outcome: Feature documentation distinguishes retained reservation history from capacity accounting after re-enrollment or revocation and preserves runtime authority limits.
acceptance: central-control-plane.md and federation-entrypoints.md state that permanently retired enrollment reservations stop consuming declared capacity while their records remain retained.

The documentation explicitly preserves current-enrollment reservations through transient links/settings/verification loss and states that accounting retirement grants no runtime ownership, completion or reconciliation authority.
